mcp_tools.title: Strict typescript engineering pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a strict TypeScript record (tsconfig strictness, no-any typing discipline, schema-validated boundaries with declared boundary rows, discriminated-union state modelling, modules with declared module rows, async discipline, tests/build tooling, red lines) and returns a deterministic STRICT_TYPESCRIPT_ENGINEERING_PACK_READY / STRICT_TYPESCRIPT_ENGINEERING_PACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across eight sections, including computed strict-flag, per-boundary schema and per-module any-free coverage, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared record only; compiles no code.

inputSchema.description: The strict typescript engineering pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All 39 checks pass. Computed spot checks: boundaries_count=1, modules_count=1, strict_flag_coverage=1.000000
